text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Air
Shakur...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I notice Air Shakur eyeing a claw
machine filled
with Umamusume
plushies.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I've analyzed claw machines before.
They're
games that utilize a fusion of
digital and
mechanical technology.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
From what I've ascertained, grabbin' a
plushie
should be a piece of cake if you
do it right.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Sure, show me what ya got. Make sure
you factor
in the plushie's weight
distribution and the track
the claw
moves on.
choice_data_list: Then I'll give it a try.
Then I'll give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
